description: This script fetches the OpenAPI specification from a given URL (defaulting to 'http://localhost:8000'), validates the presence of essential fields ('openapi', 'info', 'paths'), and prints the validation result along with the API's title if available.

methods.name: fetch(base: str)
methods.description: Fetches the OpenAPI JSON from the specified base URL and returns it as a Python dictionary.

methods.name: int main()
methods.description: Main function that retrieves the OpenAPI spec from the command-line argument or default URL, validates required keys, and outputs the result.
